messages:
pagerduty-bot: [PAGER] ✖ HIGH - reserved-gpu-pool 'resv-prod-1' at ~100% utilization for tenant AcmeCorp. Alert triggered 1745601234.

oncall_sre (Pranav): I'm on it. Seeing queue length spike on resv-prod-1 — avg wait ~320s, nodes at 100% GPU mem.

marie (SRE): Confirmed. Autoscaler attempted scale up but failed: cloud API quota error and max_nodes hit in zone-us-west.

pranav: Trying manual scale: `infra scale-reserved --pool resv-prod-1 +4` — getting rate limit from cloud api (403).

ops-lead (Carlos): Customer impact: AcmeCorp reporting increased 429s and timeouts on embedding endpoints. CS looped in. Marking P1 for now.

support-jordan: AcmeCorp support channel: they see embedding timeouts and some LLM responses failing. They're impacted for production traffic.

infra-bot: Autoscaler log snippet:
```
2024-10-19T01:34:05Z autoscaler: scale_attempt -> requested=+4
2024-10-19T01:34:07Z cloud-api: quota_error 403 'regional-gpu-quota-exceeded'
2024-10-19T01:34:08Z autoscaler: backoff
```

pranav: Looks like regional GPU quota exhausted. Checking alternate regions and other reserved pools for borrowing capacity.

marie: Immediate mitigations: 1) route Acme to fallback/smaller model variants, 2) identify noisy tenants on resv-prod-1 and pause/evict if safe, 3) attempt cross-region diversion.

pranav: Implementing routing fallback: temporarily routing embedding traffic to smaller variant. Command: `route set acme/embeddings -> fallback-models:llama-30b`

ops-lead: Also recommend evicting low-priority long-running jobs. Logs show tenant 'greenleaf-dev' holding ~63% GPU time on several nodes.

marie: Greenleaf-dev appears to be running a large eval batch. We should request a pause first, escalate to eviction only if needed.

infra-bot: Sending pause request: `jobctl pause --tenant greenleaf-dev --reason 'incident mitigation: reserved pool saturation'`

greenleaf-eng (automated): @infra-bot Received pause request for job ids [345,346]. Acknowledged. Will pause in 30s.

pranav: Paused greenleaf jobs, freed ~2 GPU-equivalents. Queue length decreased by ~18% immediately.

support-jordan: CS update to AcmeCorp: "We're rerouting some traffic to fallback models and working on freeing capacity. You may see reduced throughput/quality for some requests — working to restore full capacity."

customer-success-amy: AcmeCorp agreed to temporary fallback for embeddings, but asked for RCA and ETA for normal service recovery.

marie: Submitted cloud quota escalation (case 234567). Provider ETA 2-4 hours. For now, we should divert heavier traffic to resv-prod-2 in us-east and enable cross-region routing.

pranav: Patching router: `router patch acme region-prefer:us-east fallback:true` — redirecting new embedding requests. Monitoring delta.

infra-bot: Route change applied. Telemetry: embeddings QPS -> us-east increased; p99 latency for routed requests improved from 3.4s -> 1.2s for ~60% of traffic.

ops-lead (Carlos): Enable conservative concurrency limits for shared/resv pools: `policy set shared concurrency=2` to reduce noisy burst impact.

marie: Noted for postmortem: autoscaler did not surface the regional-quota error as a separate alert in the first 2 minutes — alerting gap. Need better error shaping and runbook.

pranav: Current status: resv-prod-1 at ~85% utilization, queue trending down. Acme error rate from ~30% -> <5%. Monitoring for regression.

support-jordan: AcmeCorp: "Thanks, seeing improvement but still some degraded responses. Please call if full capacity not restored within 3 hours."

ops-lead: I'll join a call if it stays degraded. Who's owning the postmortem? Marie?

marie: I'll own SEV writeup. Action items: 1) quota escalation follow-up, 2) autoscaler alert fix, 3) routing fallback doc, 4) tenant eviction playbook update, 5) preemptive soft-eviction policy for long-running evals.

customer-success-amy: I'll keep Acme updated and gather all failure timestamps and examples for the RCA.

pranav: Also adding a sticky: we should add a health signal for cloud quota exhaustion to incident bot so it creates a high-priority alert earlier.

marie: Agreed. Adding to backlog and will PR the alert rule change today.

pagerduty-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigations in place, severity lowered to MEDIUM. Next update in 30m or on call.

oncall_sre (Pranav): Still watching logs. Will escalate if queue > 200 pending or error rate rises.

support-jordan: Tagging support ticket: https://redwood.app/tickets/ACME-4521 — adding timeline entries and public customer notes.

ops-lead: Thanks team. Postmortem + timeline due EOD tomorrow.

marie: Dumping logs/metrics to shared folder: /mnt/incidents/1745601234/ (perf graphs, autoscaler logs, router diffs).

pranav: Closing active ops loop for now; keeping thread pinned for visibility.

infra-bot: Automated follow-up: incident checklist created -> incident-1745601234.
